short: text with stripped or mangled accents
notes: Card: ' la' x7, in strings with broken encoding or missing accents. The - pole promotes é and fires right before it (caf, clich, Sant), so the two poles read as two sides of 'accent expected or absent'; not tested here. Probes: stripped French 0.97 and 0.64, mangled Spanish 0.79; correctly accented twins 0.19 and 0.01; plain unaccented French with no accent due 0.16.
